title: Red Lentil Dal
description: Vegetarian red lentil dal with ginger, cumin and garam masala, finished with spinach and lemon. Blend it briefly for a smooth restaurant-style texture.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the water amount may need adjusting depending on how thick you like it.

items.item: steamed basmati rice or naan, fresh coriander and natural yoghurt

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Add the onion ({{onion}}), garlic ({{garlic}} cloves), ginger ({{ginger}}) and chilli ({{chilli}}), if using, to the bowl. Chop 5 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Add the ghee ({{ghee}}) and cumin seeds ({{cumin-seeds}}). Sauté 4 min / 120°C / Speed 1, MC off.

steps.title: Bloom the spices
steps.text: Add the turmeric ({{turmeric}}), ground coriander ({{ground-coriander}}) and half the garam masala ({{garam-masala*0.5}}). Cook 1 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the lentils ({{lentils}}), tomatoes ({{tomatoes}}), water ({{water}}) and salt ({{salt}}). Cook 25 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, MC off with the simmering basket on the lid, until the lentils have collapsed.

steps.title: Smooth (optional)
steps.text: For a smooth, restaurant-style dal, blend 10 sec / Speed 4. Skip this for a rustic texture.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the spinach ({{spinach}}), lemon juice ({{lemon}}) and the remaining garam masala ({{garam-masala*0.5}}). Cook 1 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir, just to wilt. Taste for salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest 5 minutes; it thickens as it stands. Serve with rice or naan, coriander and a spoon of yoghurt.

notes.title: Tadka (optional)
notes.text: For more punch, heat 1 tbsp ghee in a small pan with 1 tsp cumin seeds, a sliced garlic clove and a pinch of chilli flakes until sizzling and golden, then pour over the dal at the table.

notes.title: Thickness
notes.text: Dal thickens a lot as it cools. Loosen leftovers with a splash of hot water when reheating.

notes.title: Creamier version
notes.text: Replace 200g of the water with coconut milk.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: 5 days in the fridge, 3 months in the freezer.
